business_problem: Typeform wanted to move beyond static forms and make customer data collection feel conversational while still handling routing, computation, multilingual interactions, and downstream analysis at scale.
solution_summary: Typeform built Formless on GPT-3.5 Turbo and GPT-4 so businesses can create AI-driven conversations instead of manually designing traditional forms. A creator now supplies basic instructions about what information to collect, and the models generate the conversational flow, decide what question should come next, and support two-way exchanges where respondents can ask clarifying questions just as they would with a person. The same stack also handles computation, conditionals, routing, brand voice adaptation, multilingual translation based on browser language, and AI-based analysis of the completed responses. After the conversation finishes, Typeform converts those natural-language responses into whatever structure the business requires and exposes DataPilot so users can ask questions about results and connect information from multiple sources. That turns form creation, completion, and analysis into one continuous AI-assisted workflow.

solution_components.name: Formless
solution_components.role: Provides the conversational front end where businesses define prompts and respondents interact with the AI flow.

solution_components.name: GPT-3.5 Turbo
solution_components.role: Helps generate and manage the conversational form behavior and response handling.

solution_components.name: GPT-4
solution_components.role: Supports richer reasoning for dynamic questioning, routing, and result analysis in Formless.

solution_components.name: DataPilot
solution_components.role: Lets business users ask questions about collected results and act on the resulting insights.

data_flow: Business users define collection goals in Formless, GPT-3.5 Turbo and GPT-4 turn those instructions into a live multilingual conversation, respondent answers are normalized into structured data, and DataPilot then lets teams query the results and combine them with other information sources.
business_outcome: Typeform made form creation and response analysis far more conversational, reduced the work needed to build advanced form logic, and gave customers a faster path from raw answers to actionable insights.
metrics: ten times easier to make delightful and extremely powerful form experiences
